name: hookpost
description: Draft, schedule and review social media posts on the channels you connected in Hookpost.

interface.longDescription: Hookpost is a social media scheduler. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask for posts in plain words: ChatGPT lists the channels you connected in Hookpost (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky and more), reads each network's rules and limits, writes a post for each network, and saves them as drafts in your Hookpost calendar, or schedules them for the time you choose. You can also ask what is scheduled this week, find empty days in your calendar, attach an image or video from a public URL, and change the settings of a post that has not gone out yet. Nothing is published without your instruction, and posts cannot be deleted from ChatGPT; you manage everything in the Hookpost app at https://hookpost.hookstep.in. Sign in with your Hookpost account; ChatGPT only sees the workspace you authorize. New workspaces get 3 free posts with no card needed; then Standard is $19/month or Pro $29/month.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my Hookpost channels, then draft a LinkedIn post about our new feature for tomorrow at 10am.
